sql.notification.findByIds: select id, user_id, notification_topic_id, title, body, priority, metadata, message_read_tsz from flow.notification where id = any (:ids::bigint[])
sql.notification.getUnreadByUserPageable: select id, user_id, notification_topic_id, title, body, priority, metadata, message_read_tsz from flow.notification where message_read_tsz is null and user_id = :userId order by priority desc, date_created desc limit :limit offset :offset
sql.notification.getUnreadByUser: select id, user_id, notification_topic_id, title, body, priority, metadata, message_read_tsz from flow.notification where message_read_tsz is null and user_id = :userId order by priority desc, date_created desc
sql.notification.getUnreadByUser.count: select count(1) from flow.notification where message_read_tsz is null and user_id = :userId
sql.notification.getUnreadByUserAfterId: select id, user_id, notification_topic_id, title, body, priority, metadata, message_read_tsz from flow.notification where message_read_tsz is null and user_id = :userId and id > :afterId order by priority asc, date_created desc
sql.notification.markAsRead: update flow.notification set message_read_tsz = now(), date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById where id = any (:ids::bigint[]) and user_id = :userId
